about.what: Full US and GB rows for 27 services with every consumer tier the official US/UK pricing pages sell today (individual, duo, family, student, usage/feature tiers, monthly and yearly). Same row format as prices-2026-11.json.
about.replaces: US and GB rows in prices-2026-11.json for these services
about.amounts: amountMinor in cents (USD) or pence (GBP). 1999 = 19.99. Regular price after any free trial, intro or sale offer. US prices exclude sales tax; UK prices include VAT.

status.verified: Every plan in the row was read today from the official page in 'source' (plus any extra official pages named in 'note').

about.ids: Existing plan ids kept (same plan = same id). New ids are in newPlanIds. Plans billed every 4 weeks or every 6 months are left out because Ditch only stores weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly; notes say so where it happens. One-off purchases (lifetime, add-ons, credit bundles, boosts) are not plans.
about.sourceChanges: Rows moved from the App Store to the service's own website where the website shows prices: deezer US, strava US, headspace US, peloton US/GB, babbel US, economist GB, uber-one US. This changes some amounts (the App Store price is often higher): deezer US premium 14.99 -> 11.99, family 22.99 -> 19.99; peloton US app-one 15.99 -> 12.99, app-one-yearly 159 -> 129; babbel US all-yearly 107.99 -> 107.40.
